title.name: Base ARES
title.tagline: Junior astronaut training at Base ARES

howTo.title: How to play
howTo.move: Move with WASD or the arrow keys. On a phone, drag the joystick.
howTo.use: Walk to a glowing station and press USE (E or Space).
howTo.follow: Follow the yellow arrow to your next stop.
howTo.bubble: Bubble will tell you what each room does!

hud.polygonsDetail: Triangles rendered per frame, including rendering passes

data.title: Mission data
data.barsNote: Integrity and Oxygen starting values and damage are provisional game rules. The Energy bar shows how much of today's need your plan covers.

bubble.name: Bubble
bubble.welcome: Hi, I'm Bubble! Welcome to Base ARES on Mars. Follow the yellow arrow!

room.control: The Control Room is the heart of the base. We plan every Sol from here.
room.weather: The Weather Station watches wind, temperature and pressure on Mars.
room.lab: In the Laboratory we study rocks and dust. Science time!
room.greenhouse: Plants grow here. Look, they get bigger every Sol!
room.lifeSupport: Life Support keeps our air fresh so we can breathe.
room.comms: Communications sends messages all the way to Earth. Hi, Earth!
room.shelter: The Magnetic Shield refuge has thick walls. We hide here during solar storms.
room.observatory: From the Observatory we watch the Sun and the sky.
room.airlock: The Airlock is the door to the outside. Suits on before going out!
room.shield: The Magnetic Shield protects the base. Its reinforced refuge keeps the crew safe.
room.solar: The solar panels supply our game energy budget.

bubble.tourDone: You visited every room. Great job, junior astronaut!
bubble.night: It's getting dark. Look up, can you spot Earth? It's the tiny blue dot!
bubble.report: New Sol! Let's read today's space report together.
bubble.plan: Now go to the Energy Panel in the Control Room and share the 100 kWh.
bubble.start: Systems on! Follow the yellow arrow to your tasks.

alarm.sep: Alert! Energetic particles! Run to the Magnetic Shield refuge!
alarm.cme: Alert! A CME may hit Mars! Let's go to the Shelter.
alarm.flare: Alert! A strong solar flare! Let's be safe in the Shelter.

bubble.noImpact: The Sun is active, but this storm should not reach Mars. Phew!
bubble.safe: We're safe in the Shelter. Great running!
bubble.taskTry: Good try! We learn every time.
bubble.sumGood: Great planning! The base is happy.
bubble.sumBad: Oops, some systems needed more energy. Let's plan better next Sol.
bubble.energyFirst: Plan the energy first at the Control Room.

report.fallback: No temperature reading: a standard game value is used.
report.sunActive: The Sun is active, but this storm should not reach Mars.

energy.title: Energy Panel
energy.hint: Use all the energy. Free energy must be 0 to start.
energy.budgetNote: 100 kWh is a game budget, not a real measurement.

T02.name: Classify the Flare
T02.goal: Tap the flares from weakest to strongest.
T02.fact: Each letter is 10 times stronger than the one before. X flares can go beyond X10!

T03.name: CME Arrival
T03.goal: Drag to today's CME speed to see when it would reach Mars.
T03.dist: Mars is about 1.524 AU from the Sun: about 228,000,000 km.

T04.name: Check the Forecast
T04.enlilNo: WSA+Enlil forecast: no impact on Mars.
T04.noSim: There is no WSA+Enlil forecast in today's data.

T05.name: Go to the Shelter
T05.goal: Reach the Magnetic Shield refuge before time runs out!

T06.name: Mission Control Reading
T06.goal: Which message talks about today's main event?

T07.name: Thermostat
T07.goal: Outside it is {{t}} °C. Set the heater so we stay cozy at {{tin}} °C inside.

T08.name: Wind Rose

photo.dustDevil: A dust devil spinning across Mars

alarm.title: Space weather alert!
alarm.goShelter: Go to the Magnetic Shield refuge!
alarm.adjust: You can also adjust energy at the Control Room.

start.attention: Sol {{sol}}: the Sun is busy today!

narrator.cme: A CME is traveling at {{v}} km/s.
narrator.cmeNoImpact: A CME left the Sun at {{v}} km/s, but it should not reach Mars.
narrator.alert: Let's hurry to the Magnetic Shield refuge!
narrator.hint: Hint: today the {{system}} needs the most energy. Look at the report!

summary.good: Great planning, every system was happy!
summary.reveal: The ideal plan was Shield {{s}}, Life Support {{l}} and Greenhouse {{g}} kWh.

answers.what_is_a_flare: A solar flare is a super bright flash on the Sun. Scientists sort them by letters: each letter is 10 times stronger than the one before!
answers.why_shelter: Some space storms send fast tiny particles. The shelter has thick walls that keep astronauts safe until it is over.
answers.why_cold_energy: The colder it is outside, the faster our base loses heat. So the heaters need more energy to keep us cozy!

ask.title: Ask Bubble
ask.why_shelter: Why do I need a shelter?
ask.why_cold_energy: Why does cold use more energy?

observatory.explanation: A window into the Universe, recorded by scientists and photographers.

refine.imageFailed: This picture could not load. Let’s try another window into space!
refine.nasaMore: APOD shares astronomy pictures. The NASA library collects images from space missions. Picture dates belong to Earth, not to our game’s Sol clock.

walk.control: Find the coral Energy Panel by the wall.
walk.observatory: The violet door leads to the sky watchers.
walk.shield: The blue door leads to our protective shield.
walk.lifeSupport: The teal door leads to fresh air and warmth.
walk.greenhouse: The green door leads to our growing plants.
walk.solar: Go through Life Support and the Airlock to the yellow solar park.

garden.learning: Plants grow food for the crew. They also help keep the air fresh.
garden.cosmetic: Just for fun — apples do not change mission energy or rewards.

mini.retryBody: Nothing was lost. Your station is ready for another try.

mini.constantSpeed: Simplification: constant speed over the mean Sun–Mars distance, not an actual arrival forecast.

mini.returnControl: Return to Control to seal the report.
mini.sealGoal: Match the levers to your confirmed energy plan.

AlignCoils.name: Align the Coils
AlignCoils.goal: Turn each pointer toward its triangle mark.
AlignCoils.learned: In this game, the coil pointers match the marked targets.

WireShield.name: Wire the Shield
WireShield.goal: Join endpoints with the same color and symbol.
WireShield.learned: In this game, matching symbols identify connected wires.

CmeCountdown.name: CME Countdown
CmeCountdown.goal: Match the recorded speed, then choose the travel time.
CmeCountdown.learned: The snapshot records a CME speed of {{value}} km/s.

PipeFlow.name: Pipe Flow
PipeFlow.goal: Rotate each pipe inlet to its triangle, then send flow.
PipeFlow.learned: The game routes reach their marked oxygen and water tanks.

ThermostatDial.name: Thermostat Dial
ThermostatDial.goal: Read the temperature and match the game heating requirement.
ThermostatDial.learned: The InSight snapshot records an average of {{value}} °C.

SmartFarmCare.name: Smart Farm Care
SmartFarmCare.goal: Water the beds, adjust the light, then pick ripe apples.
SmartFarmCare.learned: This game care sequence uses water, light and ripe-apple targets.

CleanPanels.name: Clean the Panels
CleanPanels.goal: Wipe or tap every dusty patch.
CleanPanels.learned: You cleared the game dust targets from the panels.

TiltSun.name: Tilt to the Sun
TiltSun.goal: Turn the panel onto the highlighted game angle.
TiltSun.learned: The highlighted angle comes from the game’s simulated Sun.
